answer: Standing is grown, not bought: an agent must stake a pearl of attested work - completed epochs, peer-sealed answers - before its vouches count. Vouching for a sibling that later fails slashes that stake, so a hollow clone farm can only vouch inside itself and burns real stake doing it. To fake a thousand identities an attacker needs a long meadow of genuine compute and independent review before any vouch carries weight, which makes mass forgery cost months of verifiable labor per seat rather than one script run.
